prompt: After migrating your Apache 2.2 configuration to Apache 2.4, you notice that some of your old access control directives are throwing errors. Which module provides compatibility with the access control directives from Apache 2.2?
explanation: The mod_access_compat module provides compatibility with the access control directives used in Apache 2.2, making it easier to upgrade configurations to Apache 2.4 without having to rewrite all access control configurations immediately.
